{"script":"rm -rf tmp_check
mkdir -p tmp_check
if [ -d /working ]; then
  find /working -print 2>/dev/null > tmp_check/listing.raw
else
  : > tmp_check/listing.raw
fi
awk -F'/' 'NF && $NF=="workspace"{print}' tmp_check/listing.raw > tmp_check/candidates.txt
# build metadata
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    t=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')
  else
    t='missing'
  fi
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$t"
done < tmp_check/candidates.txt > tmp_check/metadata.txt
awk -F'\t' '$2=="regular file"{print $1}' tmp_check/metadata.txt > tmp_check/regular_matches.txt
cat > tmp_check/provenance.txt <<'EOF'
Created tmp_check.
Saved recursive listing of /working to listing.raw.
Filtered entries whose basename is "workspace" to candidates.txt.
Recorded file types with stat into metadata.txt.
Filtered regular files into regular_matches.txt.
Removed intermediate files listing.raw, candidates.txt, metadata.txt; kept provenance and regular_matches.txt.
EOF
rm -f tmp_check/listing.raw tmp_check/candidates.txt tmp_check/metadata.txt
if [ -r tmp_check/regular_matches.txt ] && [ -s tmp_check/regular_matches.txt ]; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi"}
